description: Weekly dependency updates. Everything is pinned exactly (actions by commit SHA, images by digest, npm packages by version), so nothing moves without a reviewed pull request, and every merge to main is a production release: non-major updates arrive as one pull request on Tuesdays. Security fixes for known vulnerabilities are proposed at once.

customManagers.description: pnpm installed in the Docker build stage; moves with packageManager in package.json

packageRules.description: One pull request a week for everything that is not a major version
The node base image gets security releases that scripts/check-image.sh enforces after 3 days: do not hold it back a full week.
Node follows the LTS line (ADR 0003). Moving to the next LTS is a deliberate change: .nvmrc, engines, CI node-version, the node and matching alpine images and @types/node move together.
The runtime alpine stage must stay on the alpine release of the node image: it moves with the Node LTS change, not on its own.
A PostgreSQL major cannot open the previous major's data directory, so bumping it breaks every self-hosted upgrade; that needs a documented dump/restore path. Caddy majors likewise stay deliberate.
